'''Tiefland''' is a Rhovlandian region associated with mining districts and the [[Rontzken]] language.

The extracted Rontzken source links Tiefland to highland or mining communities and to the language's extensive technical vocabulary for underground work, ore, stone, tunnels, and metallurgy.

== Draft Scope ==

This page preserves Tiefland as a named regional anchor without deciding whether it is a province, historical district, cultural region, or administrative mining zone.
